|errata_history=This is the original printed text. The later errata version is [[Nute Gunray's Bounty (Errata)]] (PC-E1, the current text). The Virtual Block 5 release-sheet slip ([[:File:VB5-19-Nute_Gunrays_Bounty.png]]) and the Players Committee card image ([[:File:VB5-D-nutegunraysbounty-pre.gif]]) on this page show this text. No published image shows the errata text; [[Nute Gunray's Bounty (Errata)]] uses a CardMaker recreation ([[:File:VB5-19-Nute_Gunrays_Bounty-PC-E1-cardmaker.png]]).
* '''Original''' (this page): text as given in the Virtual Block 5 release sheet (official text as of 7 December 2009): “Deploy on Amidala or opponent's senator. During your move phase, unless a Jedi here, your alien bounty hunter present may capture and seize that character. During your control phase, if that character is escorted by an alien, opponent loses 1 Force.”<ref name="sheet-VirtualBlock5">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock5.pdf Virtual Block 5 release sheet] ("Official text as of 7 December 2009"). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261027095234/https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock5.pdf Internet Archive]</ref> The Master List (official text as of 27 April 2013) prints this text again (Dark Side, p. 29). That copy is a stale reprint, not a new version, because the PC website card list already showed the later text of [[Nute Gunray's Bounty (Errata)]] (wiki versions ruling, 8 November 2026).<ref name="ml-ds">[[Media:Virtual_Legacy_Final_Master_DS.pdf|Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (Dark Side)]], cover "official text as of April 27, 2013" (PDF built February 2014). Original: http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterDS.pdf. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20170704232650/http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterDS.pdf Internet Archive]</ref>
* '''PC-E1''' ([[Nute Gunray's Bounty (Errata)]]): The PC website card list (shown there by 21 July 2012, the earliest archived capture with text, and still on 11 January 2013) reads “sieze” for “seize” (typo as published): “Deploy on Amidala or opponent's senator. During your move phase, unless a Jedi here, your alien bounty hunter present may capture and sieze that character. During your control phase, if that character is escorted by an alien, opponent loses 1 Force.”<ref name="cl-1250_19-2012-07-21">Players Committee website card list (VBlock5Type), as captured [https://web.archive.org/web/20120721064732/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock5Type.html 2012-07-21], [https://web.archive.org/web/20121211205224/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock5Type.html 2012-12-11] and [https://web.archive.org/web/20130111153832/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock5Type.html 2013-01-11] (Internet Archive); the Virtual master list (VMasterType) shows the same text from 2012-07-21 to 2013-01-11; the captures of March to May 2013 carry no game text</ref>
